Branche ton propre stockage compatible S: Connect your own S3-compatible storage: Cloudflare R2 (10 GB free, free downloads), Backblaze B2, AWS S3, MinIO… Credentials stay on this computer, in Aryadne's config folder: they are never copied into the vault.

Coupe minimale pour que chaque îlot se d: Minimal cut so each island unfolds flat (a cylinder = one straight seam), seams in folds and hollows, splits where it stretches too much, then merges neighboring islands
Coutures automatiques avancées, dépliage: Advanced automatic seams, unwrap, straightened and packed islands

0 : flux le plus régulier possible. Plus: 0: most regular flow. Higher: loops follow the forms (limbs, creases), at the cost of a few more poles.
Les quads rétrécissent là où les boucles: Quads shrink where loops converge instead of getting distorted.
Au-delà de cet angle, une arête devient: Above this angle, an edge becomes a crisp loop of the mesh (0: off). Open borders are always followed.
